biotools.summary: Browser-based virtual real-time PCR workbench for research and training (under active development; not validated for laboratory use). Simulates a 384-well plate, amplification curves, block-temperature behaviour and configurable preparation or instrument faults. Assisted forms, visual blocks and a voice console create reusable JSON batch profiles with run groups, extraction counts, PCR replicates and controls. Raw .rdmlt exports (draft telemetry packages around an RDML core) retain simulated fluorescence, SOP information, run metadata, timestamps and telemetry. Selected runs open in bundled MISSY for Cq-based results, SOP checks, interactive curves and telemetry control charts. English and Simplified Chinese interfaces; optional on-device English speech recognition with wake-word interruption. Runs offline in a compatible desktop browser after download; experiment processing stays on the user's computer. Outputs are artificial data.
